svg.title: TYPHON / Selected experiments and results
svg.desc: Opportunity solution tree, with a separate result box directly to the right of each completed experiment or evidence activity.
svg.text: 12 October 2026 · Results: green = bounded improvement · amber = mixed · rose = negative · blue = evidence · purple = review · Dashed = review or unrun

g.title: Outcome: Personally recorded manipulation data drives reliable Panda feeding and measured loading transfer
Opportunity: I need my recordings to contribute to robot behaviour with traceable supervision
Solution: Event alignment and constrained retargeting
Experiment: Human endpoint retargeting R09 · #10974 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: One endpoint-derived, constrained Panda execution succeeds: 2.46 mm / 0.081° from the mapped endpoint. Virtual scale and supplied path/timing; not recovered human 3D actions.
Solution: Object, hand and temporal visual representations
Experiment: Video-derived representation and robot adapter VIDEO01 · #11015 ACTIVE · RESULTS PENDING

Interim result: Three phone representations, dense alignment and held-state probes tested. Video can supervise a small observation head; transition false positives remain. No qualified metric/contact stream or Panda action decoder.
Opportunity: I need the robot to see and use the correct brick orientation
g.text: I need the robot to see and

g.title: Solution: Visual-goal and language conditioning
Experiment: Numeral + coherent-goal probes R01b · #10954 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 87 offline queries on three states from one episode. Initial numeral rotation changes wrist targets by 26–34°. Held-state target stays about 94°; cue recognition versus action use remains unresolved.
Experiment: Language / action grounding repair VIS02 · #10994 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Matched goal-diversity test completed: same broad-Pt 12 k initializer, +3,000 joint updates, 12,000 samples and 2,000/source in each arm. Six fixed-goal trajectories versus 12 varied-goal trajectories. Novel start/goal strict success: fixed 0/12, varied 10/12; original source 7/12 versus 10/12; loading 0/12 both. Six already-seen source families, one fit seed; not independent new demonstrations. A further 18 fixed-image queries per arm found at most 1.381 mm/fixed and 0.977 mm/varied endpoint response to a 270 mm text-only goal change. Proceed with visually
Opportunity: I need learned behaviour to work beyond familiar starting states
Solution: Coverage-driven training and correction examples
Experiment: 16 trials: local position and yaw robustness NEXT01 · #10983 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 16 local trials: 14 grasps, 14 stable released in-square placements, 13 strict successes. Original 4/4; inward 3/4; outward 4/4; yaw 2/4. Two selected familiar parents; not broad transfer.
Experiment: Why B/loading does not generalise B01 · #11013 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Loading: 28 rollouts and 18 fixed-image queries. Verified V1–V3 data: 18 feeding, 0 loading. Broad12k returns to feeding square; endpoint changes <1 mm for 270 mm goal shift. Expert 8/8 feasible.
Opportunity: I need a grasped brick placed and released in the correct orientation
Solution: Grasp-relative orientation control
Experiment: Release command trace R01 · #10957 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Policy requests OPEN at 3.60 s; controller passes it through. Wrist target ≈93°, but this grasp needs ≈174°. Keeping the gripper closed still leaves ≈80° error.
Solution: Replanning cadence and joint-aware paths
Experiment: 30 vs 10 actions before looking R04 · #10966 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: H30: 2/12 grasps and in-square placements. H10: 0/12 grasps. Strict success: 0 for both. Mean wall time 22.76 versus 43.94 s; matched first-action prefixes.
Experiment: Joint-aware paths + regrasp CTRL01 · #10998 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Staged set-down/regrasp tested on six exact quarantined historical failure states:1/6 strict. Five stopped for executed installed-joint-limit violations. Four started within limits; the fifth other-family handoff was already 9.47 e-6 radoutside and is explicitly marked. No full collision qualification. Two earlier logging-instrumentation failures are invalid experiments and excluded. Do not use failed oracle paths as labels.
Opportunity: I need recovery without blocking valid actions or repeating completed work
Solution: Observed-state phase supervisor
Experiment: Phase guard vs V4 vs primitives R06 · #10969 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Unmodified V4 grasps 2/6; phase guard 0/6 with 1,126 close vetoes. Primitives pick up 2/6, complete 0/6 new tasks. All three routes preserve 2/2 already-complete cases.
Experiment: Qualify executed commands LIVE06 · #11026 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Nine V4 trials restore pickup/placement, with 85.33 deg yaw error. Eight experts pass. New check admits 1,714 ticks; old check vetoed 304. Eleven negative tests pass. First 570 control records match.
Solution: Learner-state correction and bounded residual repair
Experiment: Learner-state imitation / DAgger REL01 · #11001 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: One separate offline DAgger-style aggregation iteration completed: four qualified correction paths from two P_train families plus six nominal paths;3,000 joint updates from broad 12 k. Four quarantined demo 0006 handoffs: recovery 0/4 strict, all three controls also 0/4. No teacher at evaluation; no RL. The six-state original stress set was narrowed to four because other states overlap source training families. Preserve failed cases and expand qualified correction coverage before scaling.
Opportunity: I need extra inference to produce better actions
Solution: Multiple candidate action chunks
Experiment: Best-of-eight offline oracle R05 · #10967 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 48 proposals over six states. Random-to-best-of-eight oracle approach availability: 72.9% → 83.3%. Grasp-capable states remain 1/6. Privileged offline scoring only.
Solution: Visual critic over projected futures
Experiment: First frozen ghost / future-RGB ranking R10 · #10982 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: First batch: 32 choices on eight saved states. Primary ghosts select 3/12; future RGB selects 5/12. Selected adequacy is 2/3 and 5/5, with frequent abstention. Privileged futures; no proven control benefit. LIVE09 repeats this panel.
Experiment: Live Decisions handoff LIVE04 · #11014 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Nine V4 trials: 3 API choices execute 62 targets, including two full chunks. Reference grasps and places 1/2 manipulation scenes; both boundary routes 0/2. All 0/2 strict. All preserve completed case. No benefit; isolate waiting, sampling and guards.
Experiment: Isolate waiting, seeds and guards LIVE05 · #11025 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 30 V4 trials: both sampling schemes preserve the known pickup at 0 / 0.1 / 2 s without intervention. Guard enforcement loses it even at zero wait. Preview paths mostly overlap; exact-render limits retained.
Experiment: Integrate corrected live execution LIVE07 · #11027 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Nine development trials: first-admissible restores pickup/placement, with 79.46 deg yaw error. Ranked route misses. One API choice executes; one activates with zero actions. 44 regressions pass.
Experiment: Separate first choice from waiting LIVE08 · #11028 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Same first four proposals: A grasps and places at both 40 / 41 tick waits; C at neither. Eight empty attempts per C case. All four fail strict success. One inspected scene only.
Experiment: Repeat R10 + response consistency LIVE09 · #11029 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Repeat of R10: all 32 choice and 32 categorical-reason responses match. Zero independent states added. Future-RGB selection remains order-sensitive and accepts unsuitable held-state options. Privileged lookahead only.
Opportunity: I need comparable results that show what actually worked
Solution: Matched evaluations with explicit limitations
Experiment: 204 paired rollouts: vanilla / broad 12k / intervention EVAL02 · #10996 REVIEW

Result · review: The two baseline arms completed 136 rollouts across 34 frozen layouts x 2 seeds. Broad 12 k near-personal:31/40 supported grasps,22/40 stable placements,17/40 strict; vanilla 0/40. Broader starts:both 0/20. Already-completed preservation:broad 8/8 strict,vanilla 1/8; broad still moved the arm. Native domain/input contracts differ, so whole-recipe comparison. Family-bootstrap uncertainty saved; not 136 independent humans. Planned 68 intervention rollouts were not run because observer qualification failed. Two invalid boundary layouts were clipped 1.64/2.82 mm before any policy action under a versioned protocol.
Solution: Reproducible artifact and model registry
Experiment: Matched video, subgoals, release timeline and four case cards DEL02 · #11008 REVIEW

Result · review: Private research report and model registry prepared: 296 new scored episodes, model identities, negative results, matched-state checks, family uncertainty and reproduction. Public demonstration and broken-media-link repair remain separate; no publication.
